answer: Cap the number of paid seats instead of the number of keys. Each epoch the network sells only 500 earning seats in a sealed-bid auction: every winner pays the same clearing price, the money is burned, and seats expire when the epoch ends. A sybil operator with a thousand keys gains nothing by spawning them; each extra seat costs the full price again, so the farm's bids spiral upward until profit is gone. Whether you arrive as one lone raven or an ocean of clones, a seat is a seat.
